syllabus_extract: Introduction to sonar system. Purpose and technical details of active and passive sonar system.
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of sonar theory diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a sonar system?
Define the basic theory of communication in underwater contexts.
List two applications of sonar in naval operations.

topics: Comparison of active and passive systems
development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Sound propagation in water
Active sonar operating principle
Passive sonar operating principle
Comparison of active and passive systems

Technical details of active sonar
Technical details of passive sonar
Signal processing basics
Transducer types and functions
Echo location and target detection

Limitations of active sonar
Limitations of passive sonar
Environmental factors affecting sonar
Operational constraints
Future trends in sonar technology

summary_questions: Explain the difference between active and passive sonar detection methods.
Describe how sound waves are utilized for underwater communication.
Identify one key limitation of active sonar systems.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the transition from LP 05 to LP 06, focusing on how sonar data feeds into sonobuoy systems.
